2.3. Model Checking Besnard and Doutre [12] give a method of model checking. The method aims to translate an AF as a propositional formula in the PL2, such that the models of the propositional formula are corresponding to extensions of the AF under a kind of semantics. In fact, the core of each model is an extension of the AF and vice versa. The translating functions depend on various semantics.
